verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas ships an official, npm-published Editor MCP Server that connects AI assistants to a live Editor session to modify project data and verify the result in the viewport or a running app. Docs also point users to change scenes "from an agent with the MCP server", and new projects include PlayCanvas Skills for AI coding agents, so natural-language operation through an assistant is a first-party, documented path. missing for 10: a built-in natural-language interface inside the Editor (it requires an external AI assistant/MCP client), detail on which Editor operations are covered, and independent or hands-on corroboration of how well natural-language control works in practice.
